title: motion-pack playbook rule
description: One atomic, graded learning. playbook/rules/<area>.json holds an array of these (the id starts with the area). A rule is ENFORCED (enforce.check names a tools/playbook_checks.py check), a DEFAULT (enforce.default names a plan default that `mp plan` writes in), a PART (enforce.part is a pack id that implements it) or PROSE-ONLY (a known gap). status 'candidate' lives only in playbook/inbox/ (mp study writes it; mp rules promote publishes it). Validated by tools/playbook_build.py.

statement.description: the rule in one or two sentences, numbers included

formats.description: format ids; empty or missing = every format

section.description: the beat or section it applies to (hook, name, end, ...)

params.description: the numbers the check and the plan default read, e.g. {"quiet_open_db": [-11, -7]}

grade.description: measured-A: measured on tier A/A- references; measured: any tier; craft: seen, not tied to reach; house: a pack rule; inferred: a reading, never a fact

evidence.description: what was measured or seen, brand-free (a tier-A launch film (round 7), never the account)

promoted_to.description: inbox only: the rule id this candidate became (mp rules promote)
